title.narrative: Local Fund Agent Services for the Global Fund

description.narrative: Since the creation of the Global Fund in 2002, UNOPS has been acting as Local Fund Agent (LFA) providing monitoring and evaluation services to the Global Fund in a number of countries around the world. LFAs oversee, verify and report on grant performance. UNOPS provides this service to the Global Fund in the following countries as of May 2019: Afghanistan, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, North Macedonia, Moldova,\nMalaysia, Papua New Guinea, Tajikistan and Turkmenistan, with two additional multi country funds.\n
